story.title: Aanvi's rangoli
paragraphs_en: Aanvi enjoyed watching her mom make rangoli every morning. She tried to make a rangoli by herself.
She observed that a rangoli is a pattern drawn using dots, straight lines, curved lines and different kinds of shapes.
Aanvi began to practice drawing different shapes.
Aanvi tried to make a small rangoli, it was beautiful.
She started to make many more beautiful rangolis everyday.
Aanvi was busy making several rangolis everywhere on the floors and also on the walls.
Aanvi made a different rangoli, this time she chose to use flowers and leaves to decorate it. Her mom and sister were happy to watch Aanvi make this rangoli.
This is Aanvi's colourful and beautiful rangoli ! Do you want to try to make a rangoli?
